title: On the multiplicity of ALMA Compact Array counterparts of far-infrared bright quasars
question: Are the Herschel/SPIRE far-infrared fluxes of FIR-bright z=2-4 SDSS quasars from single sub-mm sources or from multiple counterparts, and what does this imply for major mergers as triggers?

what.value: SPIRE fluxes, SED-fit LAGN, LFIR, SFRs of quasar sample

evidence.quote: Based on the SED-fitting presented in P16, their L$_{\textrm {FIR}}$ lie between 10$^{12.8}$ and 10$^{13.8}$ L$_{\odot}$

what.value: ALMA 0.45" band 7 maps of SMGs from archive, degraded for comparison

evidence.quote: we degraded ALMA band 7 continuum maps of sub-millimetre galaxies (SMGs) at 0$.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$45 from (cite: bussmann15)
The density of SCUBA sources at 850 $\mu$m   is reported in Tab. 16 of (cite: scott06)

recipe.method: Re-ran ALMA pipeline with QA flag files, antenna position corrections and flux.csv; primary-beam corrected

recipe.goal: Identify ACA counterparts within SPIRE beam
recipe.method: Search within 11" of SPIRE coordinates; primary = unique or closest counterpart; compare with SDSS/SPIRE positions
Simulate point-source pairs, smooth to ACA beam, fit beam to primary and inspect residuals; apply same to real maps and to degraded Bussmann maps

answer_key.quantity: Quasars with unique ACA counterpart within 11"

evidence.quote: Of the 28 SDSS quasars, 19 have unique ALMA counterparts, while six and three sources have a second and third counterparts within 11
Source J233456, the source with the lowest ACA detection level, is detected at 3.5$\sigma$.
S$_{\rm res}$/S$_{\rm tot}$=0.27 at a distance of 2$.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$5

answer_key.quantity: Mean ACA offsets for six objects from SDSS and SPIRE

evidence.quote: mean offsets for those six objects of 3$.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$59 and 1$.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$62
